status: FROZEN — thresholds declared before the first probe run; do not edit after results exist
hypothesis: ACTION_FAILED_PUNISHMENT = -0.2 creates a passive reward attractor: never committing avoids the penalty, and the penalty is 37-51x louder than the terminal outcome signal. Removing it should prevent the drift to zero pickups observed at ~225,000 steps.

design.control: existing G0-v2 baseline trajectories (seeds 2500001/2/3), reused — not retrained
design.everything_else: identical to the frozen G0-v2 configuration

competence_definition.measured_on: held-out TASK_HEALTH validation panel, seeds 9300000-9300002, opponents OP6/OP9/OP12

objective_alignment_gate.requirement: task reward must NOT increase while success collapses
objective_alignment_gate.test: reward_up_while_task_down == false for every probe seed
objective_alignment_gate.rationale: this is the exact Case A signature the baseline exhibited; its absence is the thing being tested

outcome_interpretation.gate_passes: causal hypothesis supported — penalty drove the passive attractor. Next step is choosing a NON-ZERO scale, not keeping zero permanently.
outcome_interpretation.gate_fails_still_collapses: penalty was correlated but not sufficient. Return to the reward decomposition and inspect the next dominant shaping term.
outcome_interpretation.gate_fails_reckless: some failed-action penalty is useful but -0.2 is oversized. Sweep magnitude; do not return to -0.2.
outcome_interpretation.forbidden: reading a partial result and then editing these thresholds

design_principle: Shaping may guide how to play; it must never pay more than the game outcome itself.
reliability_gate_for_unlocking: at least 2 independent seeds competent under the revised configuration, then rerun weakness discovery
